The HWPX training feedback automation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust integration of LangChain graph components.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.70 across a 5-minute runtime. Pytest reported 100% success in 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' using version 7.4.4. While the LangChain graph logic is reusable, future iterations should monitor the discrepancy between the perfect verifier score and the lower judge reward to identify potential qualitative gaps.
